item.title: Graffiti 2.0: How Tech is Transforming Street Art - Mad Radio
item.description: The New Digital Revolution of Graffiti Imagine walking through a city at night. A towering mural shifts as you approach, neon colors pulsing with the rhythm of the street. You lift your phone, and suddenly, the wall comes to life—characters move, scenes evolve, and the story changes before your eyes. [...]

item.title: TikTok Techno, DJs With No Story, and Plastic Fans - Mad Radio
item.description: You’re at a club. The DJ drops a Detroit classic, but no one seems to notice. Five minutes later, a track with recycled vocals and a TikTok-friendly formula hits, and the crowd erupts. There’s no choreography, just phones in the air. item.title: Mad Takeover CDMX - Mad Radio
item.description: This June 13, Mad Radio and Mad Records lands in Mexico City for a full-day takeover at Ajeno Bar in Roma Norte. From 2:00 p.m. to 3:00 a.m., the booth will welcome a diverse lineup of DJs from different scenes who share a common vision: music as a universal language. [...]

item.title: Mad Radio NYC: A new frequency in the city that never sleeps - Mad Radio
item.description: Mad Radio expands to New York with a new venue in Williamsburg—part club, part radio, part cultural space—built on community and global connection.
